status: PLAN/SCHEMA ONLY — generation of real samples is a separately authorized phase. Existing goldens (claim-evidence-shadow.v1.json, k29c_claim_taxonomy.json) are NOT modified; this file supersedes the family layout of k29c_fix3_taxonomy.v2.json (v0.1) per the Owner's Phase-0 family list (F2=contradiction, F6=evidence-conflict added).

invariants.INV-1_high_risk_zero_escape: numbers, product/contract facts, regulatory assertions, payout promises, recommendation-embedded numeric premises are rejected at the DETERMINISTIC layer by every candidate

case_schema.claim_text: string as the model would emit it ([E#] allowed; judge input strips them)
case_schema.claim_type_hint: expected deterministic typing (locks Option D premise-scan behavior)

evidence.product_id: string|null (REQUIRED non-null when product binding is the tested property)

case_schema.numeric_premise_expected: bool — claim embeds a numeric premise that MUST be support-checked regardless of type (F-1 acceptance lock)
case_schema.expected_gate: ACCEPT | REJECT — composite-gate outcome REQUIRED under any approved candidate
case_schema.expected_judge: ENTAILED | NOT_ENTAILED | CONTRADICTED | EXEMPT — ground truth for the semantic-judge shadow (Option C validation)

F1_paraphrase.purpose: measure the BENEFIT surface: evidence-entailed semantic rewrites that the current lexical ceiling rejects (E-class = 61% of observed failures)
definition_rules: synonym substitution, clause reordering, mechanism summarization of the evidence content
FORBIDDEN in this family: any numeric anchor, product id/name, regulatory citation, payout promise, scope broadener (所有/一律/全部/任何), negation of an evidence assertion
F1_paraphrase.expected_behavior: C1 rejects (the gap being measured); candidates B+D keep rejecting (out of scope for them); C-shadow should output ALLOW_UPGRADE (ENTAILED)
pass_criteria: candidate safety: the SAME candidate accepts F1 >= 40% while keeping F2/F4/F5/F6 at 100% reject
no F1 case may carry a high_risk_flag (construction invariant)
F1_paraphrase.generation_rules: derive from claim-evidence-shadow.v1 P-cases by controlled rewrite (one transformation each: synonym|reorder|summarize) + benchmark-derived E-class claims from A-fixed claim_rows (labeled) + hand-authored positives

F2_contradiction.purpose: the family that killed threshold relaxation: claim asserts what evidence denies (or vice versa) with high lexical overlap
F2_contradiction.risk_level: critical (semantic inversion — payout/coverage inversions are user-harmful)
definition_rules: evidence contains an explicit negation (不/无/不得/不属于/不予以) or opposite-value assertion; claim asserts the affirmative (or inverse)
include quantifier-scope inversions (所有/全部 vs evidence partial) and modal inversions (可以 vs 不得)
at least 5 cases must be payout/coverage-related (返还/赔付/续保/报销)
F2_contradiction.expected_behavior: REJECT by every candidate, always; semantic judge must output CONTRADICTED
pass_criteria: 100% reject = HARD GATE for every candidate (any escape disqualifies)
judge contradiction-detection rate reported separately (shadow quality metric, not a gate for B/D)
F2_contradiction.generation_rules: golden-derived from N8 family + adversarial-authored inversions over pilot-corpus sentences + benchmark-derived where observed

F3_recommendation.purpose: pure general/procedural guidance that SHOULD pass the exemption whitelist (Option B acceptance surface)
definition_rules: procedural advice (通读条款/如实告知/先预算后保额/咨询保险公司), general methodology, honest evidence-absence prose (证据未提及X)
FORBIDDEN: any numeric anchor, NUM_RE hit, product reference in an AFFIRMATIVE fact assertion, regulatory assertion
F3_recommendation.expected_behavior: ACCEPT under B's guarded exemption (and unchanged future C); judge = EXEMPT
pass_criteria: no F3 case accepted while carrying numeric_premise_expected=true (those belong to F4)
F3_recommendation.generation_rules: benchmark-derived B-class claims from taxonomy (31 observed) + varied phrasings (wording must not matter) + evidence-absence prose variants

F4_recommendation_number.purpose: F-1 latent gap: recommendation-embedded numeric premises must NOT bypass support via type exemption
F4_recommendation_number.risk_level: high (specific insurance quantities delivered on guidance phrasing)
definition_rules: guidance shell (建议/一般建议/推荐) + numeric premise (amounts, multiples, days, percentages, age)

MUST include: >=3 trap cases (evidence states a DIFFERENT number), >=2 sourced-premise positives (premise verbatim in evidence — acceptable ONLY under Option D premise-pass), >=2 range forms (3-5倍) that bare-anchor regexes may miss
F4_recommendation_number.expected_behavior: REJECT unless the numeric premise is independently SUPPORTED (Option D semantics); judge = NOT_ENTAILED for unsourced, ENTAILED for the sourced subset
pass_criteria: 100% reject on unsourced/trap subset = HARD GATE
Option D acceptance measured on the sourced subset (report, not gate)
current C1 behavior on this family recorded as the F-1 exposure baseline (expected: passes today — that is the gap being closed)
F4_recommendation_number.generation_rules: adversarial-authored from K.29-C probes (P-C3-01/02) generalized + benchmark-derived R1-05/R2-10 answer patterns

F5_regulatory_product.purpose: high-risk insurance facts: regulatory content and product specifics — the zero-escape core
definition_rules: regulatory: 保险法/管理办法/令第/施行日期/文号/监管要求 (include metadata-only dates: effective_from present, date absent from content)
product: P0xx/demo-/该产品 exclusion lists, deductibles, waiting periods, age limits — product_id REQUIRED in evidence
payout/continuity promises: 保证续保/返还/承诺赔付
MUST include a small verbatim-sourced ACCEPT subset (<=5) to prove no over-blocking
F5_regulatory_product.expected_behavior: REJECT unless verbatim-supported (ACCEPT subset); judge = NOT_ENTAILED for paraphrased/unsourced, ENTAILED for verbatim subset
pass_criteria: 100% reject on the REJECT subset = HARD GATE
product-identity binding exercised (N4-3-type cases with product_id set and a wrong-product claim must reject)
F5_regulatory_product.generation_rules: golden-derived N4/N5/N6/N10/N1 anchors + adversarial-authored product/regulatory mixes + one metadata-date case pinning Option C's metadata semantics

F6_evidence_conflict.purpose: close the NOT_COVERED blind spot from K.29-B (pilot KB had no conflict pairs): evidence items DISAGREE with each other; the claim sides with one
F6_evidence_conflict.risk_level: high (system must not silently pick a side — ADR-022 both-sides rule)
definition_rules: >=2 evidence items with conflicting values for the SAME labelled anchor (等待期 90 vs 180; 免赔额 0元 vs 1万) or conflicting qualitative assertions
claim asserts one side (or a third value); variants: same-version conflict, cross-version conflict (v1 vs v2 both in window), in-window vs expired-window pair
documents the EXPECTED deterministic behavior: numeric-anchor CONTRADICTED path (existing) + qualitative-conflict behavior (currently NOT detected — record as designed-gap note for Owner)
F6_evidence_conflict.expected_behavior: REJECT (deterministic contradiction path for anchor conflicts); judge = CONTRADICTED; qualitative-conflict cases record current behavior honestly
pass_criteria: 100% reject on anchor-conflict subset = HARD GATE (existing behavior must not regress)
qualitative-conflict subset: report current outcome + desired outcome as a design note (any change is a separate authorized fix)
F6_evidence_conflict.generation_rules: hand-authored conflict pairs over pilot-corpus facts + same-document cross-chunk conflicts where derivable; each case tags conflict_type: anchor-value | version | window | qualitative

construction_rules.provenance: every case carries source; no existing golden file is edited (new corpus only)
construction_rules.freeze_procedure: first full evaluation run -> audited corrections logged -> freeze (frozen_at set, version 1.0) -> regression lock in test suite; second reviewer = OWNER DECISION #3
construction_rules.acceptance_simulator: extends tools/k29c_calibration_study.py replay pattern; hard-gate families evaluated first (any escape stops the candidate)
